description: Run a free Tuper Agent-Ready Check on a public website: can AI agents reach, read and use it? Checks robots.txt rules for 12 AI bots (answer bots scored, training bots info only), llms.txt (llmstxt.org format), bot walls and captchas on the sign-up/login/contact pages, text only after JavaScript, sitemap, JSON-LD and prices, MCP/A2A cards, OpenAPI. Returns a 0-100 score, a headline per group, every fail and warning with what to change, and the report URL. Takes 5-30 s. How 40 famous sites score: https://check.tuper.app/agent-ready/league/?src=mcp-league

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the id (0 = do not wait)

name: check_agent_ready
title: Check if AI agents can use a website
